name: Klink
entry: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

gift.note: Emerged from an ancient mechanism in the desert ruins.

location: Emerged from an ancient mechanism in the desert ruins.

name: Klang
entry: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.
location: Level 38 · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Klinklang
entry: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.
location: Level 49 · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Porygon
entry: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.

gift.note: Link your game to a PokeHacking account.

location: Link your game to a PokeHacking account.

name: Porygon2
entry: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can’t fly, however.
location: Trade holding Up Grade · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Porygon-Z
entry: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...
location: Trade holding Dubious Disc · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Chespin
entry: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

gift.note: One of the three Kalos starters, given at random — only one per player. Trade on the GTS for the others.

location: One of the three Kalos starters, given at random — only one per player. Trade on the GTS for the others.

name: Quilladin
entry: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.
location: Level 16 · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Chesnaught
entry: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
location: Level 36 · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Fennekin
entry: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

gift.note: One of the three Kalos starters, given at random — only one per player. Trade on the GTS for the others.

location: One of the three Kalos starters, given at random — only one per player. Trade on the GTS for the others.

name: Braixen
entry: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
location: Level 16 · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Delphox
entry: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.
location: Level 36 · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Froakie
entry: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

gift.note: One of the three Kalos starters, given at random — only one per player. Trade on the GTS for the others.

location: One of the three Kalos starters, given at random — only one per player. Trade on the GTS for the others.

name: Frogadier
entry: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.
location: Level 16 · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Greninja
entry: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
location: Level 36 · line begins with a Mystery Gift

name: Beldum
entry: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

gift.note: Distributed shiny, as thanks for contributing to the development or promotion of the game.

method: Mystery Gift — “Your contribution is very important”
location: Distributed shiny, as thanks for contributing to the development or promotion of the game.

name: Metang
entry: When two BELDUM fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.
location: Level 20 · stays shiny — the line begins with the shiny Beldum

name: Metagross
entry: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
location: Level 45 · stays shiny — the line begins with the shiny Beldum

name: Jirachi
entry: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

gift.note: Pick up the Old Sea Map at a Poké Mart, save, then travel to Desire Island.

location: Desire Island — pick up the Old Sea Map at a Poké Mart and save first

name: Shaymin
entry: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

gift.note: Thank-you card for playing. Land Forme.

location: Thank-you card for playing. Land Forme.

name: Bagon
entry: Its well-developed neck muscles and ironlike head can smash boulders into pieces.

name: Shelgon
entry: It surrounds its body in an iron-hard shell to accumulate enough power to evolve.

name: Salamence
entry: It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.

name: Gible
entry: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

name: Gabite
entry: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

name: Garchomp
entry: Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

name: Kommo-o
entry: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
